# Family EV Road Trip Guide: Singapore to Desaru Coast, Malaysia

Desaru Coast is Malaysia's premier family beach destination on the southeastern coast of Johor — less than 100 km from Singapore. With its luxury resorts, water park, 17 km of pristine beach, championship golf courses, and the Desaru Fruit Farm, it's the perfect weekend getaway for Singaporean families.

And here's the good news: **the drive from Singapore to Desaru Coast is one of the easiest EV road trips in Southeast Asia.** The total distance is just 80-100 km depending on your exact route, well within the range of every EV sold in Singapore. No range anxiety, no complicated charging logistics — just a straightforward beach vacation with your electric car.

## Route Overview

| Detail | Info |
|--------|------|
| Total driving distance | ~80-100 km (Singapore → Woodlands Checkpoint → Desaru Coast) |
| Recommended duration | 2-3 days (weekend trip) |
| Charging stops | 1 (top-up before crossing or at Desaru Coast) |
| Best EV for trip | Any EV — even a short-range Mini Electric or Wuling Air EV |
| Best time to go | March-October (dry season), weekdays for quieter beaches |
| Border crossings | Woodlands Checkpoint (Singapore side) → CIQ Johor Bahru (Malaysia side) |
| Driving side | LEFT (both Singapore and Malaysia) |

## The Route: Singapore to Desaru Coast Step by Step

### Step 1: Charge Up Before Leaving Singapore

Your first decision: charge in Singapore or charge in Malaysia?

**Charging in Singapore:** Shell Recharge, SP Group, and Charge+ have dense coverage. Top up at any HDB carpark, mall, or Shell station near your home before crossing. Recommended if you have a short-range EV (under 250 km real-world range) or want to arrive at Desaru without needing an immediate charge.

**Charging in Malaysia:** You'll pass several charging stations in Johor Bahru (JB) after crossing the causeway. The JB area has Gentari, Shell Recharge, JomCharge, and Tesla Superchargers. If you have 250+ km range, you can comfortably cross without charging in Singapore.

| Singapore Charging Networks | Speed | Cost |
|---------------------------|-------|------|
| **SP Group** (HDB carparks, malls) | 7.4kW AC / 50kW DC | S$0.55/kWh AC, S$0.65/kWh DC |
| **Shell Recharge** (Shell stations) | 50-180kW DC | S$0.65-0.75/kWh |
| **Charge+** (malls, private carparks) | 22kW AC / 50kW DC | S$0.50-0.65/kWh |
| **Tesla Supercharger** (Orchard, Sentosa) | 120-250kW DC | S$0.55-0.70/kWh |

### Step 2: Cross the Causeway (Woodlands Checkpoint)

The Woodlands Checkpoint is the busiest land border crossing in the world with ~350,000 travelers daily. Plan accordingly.

**Best crossing times:**
- **Weekday mornings (after 10 AM):** After the work commuter rush
- **Weekday afternoons (1-3 PM):** Quietest window
- **Saturday mornings (6-8 AM):** Early start beats the weekend leisure crowd
- **Avoid:** Friday evenings (5-10 PM), Sunday evenings (3-9 PM), and Monday mornings (6-9 AM)

**What you need:**
- Valid passport (both Singapore and Malaysia sides)
- Vehicle log card (for Singapore-registered cars — bring digital copy)
- Touch 'n Go card (for Malaysian tolls — essential!)
- Autopass card (issued at Malaysian customs for foreign vehicles — S$10, lasts 30 days)

**EV-specific tip:** Border crossings involve idling in queues for 30-90 minutes. This uses very little battery (AC running with car in accessory mode uses ~1-2 km range per hour). Don't worry about running the AC while queuing — it's negligible drain.

### Step 3: Johor Bahru to Desaru Coast (80 km, ~1 hour)

Once through the Malaysian checkpoint, you'll join the **Johor Bahru Eastern Dispersal Link (EDL)** and then the **Senai-Desaru Expressway (SDE)** . This is a smooth, dual-carriageway highway with a 90-110 km/h speed limit.

**Charging options en route:**

| Station | Location | Speed | Details |
|---------|----------|-------|---------|
| **Gentari** | Shell Station, Jalan Tun Abdul Razak, JB | 60kW DC CCS2 | Near the EDL entrance, good for a quick top-up after crossing |
| **JomCharge** | R&R Layang-Layang (Senai-Desaru Highway) | 50kW DC CCS2 | Rest stop with food court and surau — good family break point |
| **Shell Recharge** | Shell SDE, near Sedenak | 50kW DC CCS2 | Alternative to R&R Layang-Layang |
| **Tesla Supercharger** | AEON Mall Tebrau City (Johor Bahru) | 150kW DC | If you need a faster charge, detour 5 min off EDL to AEON Tebrau |

**Pro tip:** Top up at **R&R Layang-Layang** (50kW JomCharge) about 40 km into the drive. It's the perfect halfway stop — let the kids stretch their legs, use the restroom, grab a snack from the food court, and charge for 20 minutes. You'll arrive at Desaru Coast with a nearly full battery.

## Arriving at Desaru Coast

Desaru Coast is a 3,900-acre integrated resort development with four main components:

1. **Desaru Coast Adventure Waterpark** — Southeast Asia's largest waterpark
2. **Hard Rock Hotel Desaru Coast** — 4-star family resort
3. **The Westin Desaru Coast Resort** — 5-star luxury
4. **The Anantara Desaru Coast Resort & Villas** — Ultra-luxury villa resort
5. **The Els Club Desaru Coast** — Championship golf courses

### EV Charging at Desaru Coast

**The game-changer:** DC Handal installed a **200kW Kempower DC charger** at **Desaru Coast Riverside** (the commercial center with restaurants and shops). This is one of the fastest chargers on the entire east coast of Malaysia.

| Charger | Location | Speed | Connectors | Payment |
|---------|----------|-------|-----------|---------|
| **DC Handal** | Desaru Coast Riverside | 200kW (120kW per connector) | 2x CCS2 | Credit card (pay per kWh) |
| **Hotel AC charging** | Hard Rock Hotel / Westin | 7-22kW AC | Type 2 | Free for guests |
| **Standard socket** | Resort chalets at Tunamaya | 240V/15A | Standard plug | Use portable EVSE |

**For a weekend trip:** Plug in at the DC Handal station upon arrival (20 min to 80%), then charge overnight at your hotel's AC charger. You'll have plenty of range for local driving and the return trip.

## Best Family Hotels at Desaru Coast (with EV Charging)

### 1. Hard Rock Hotel Desaru Coast ⭐⭐⭐⭐

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **EV charging** | 4x AC Type 2 (22kW) in basement carpark, free for guests |
| **Price** | MYR 500-900/night (S$150-270) |
| **Family features** | Rock Royalty kids club, family pool with water features, teen lounge, family rooms |
| **Best for** | Families who want fun + music vibe |

The Hard Rock is the most family-conscious resort at Desaru Coast. The Rock Spa has treatments for kids, the pool has a dedicated children's section, and the kids club runs daily activities (arts, crafts, games). The AC chargers in the basement are reliable — just ask the valet to park you at the charging bay.

### 2. The Westin Desaru Coast Resort ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **EV charging** | 2x AC Type 2 (22kW), free for guests — register at reception |
| **Price** | MYR 700-1,200/night (S$210-360) |
| **Family features** | Westin Family kids club, infinity pools, family activities (drum-making, kite-flying) |
| **Best for** | Luxury family beach vacation |

The Westin sits right on the beach with gorgeous infinity pools cascading toward the ocean. The kids club is excellent (complimentary 9 AM-5 PM for kids 4-12). Family rooms have separate sleeping areas. The AC chargers are in the main carpark — 22kW is fast enough to top up overnight.

### 3. Anantara Desaru Coast Resort & Villas ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **EV charging** | 2x AC Type 2 (22kW), complimentary with valet service |
| **Price** | MYR 1,200-2,500/night (S$360-750) |
| **Family features** | Private pools in villas, kids club, bike rentals, butler service for families |
| **Best for** | Splurge-worthy family escape |

Anantara is pure luxury. The villas with private pools are incredible for families — kids can swim in the private pool while parents relax. The Anantara kids club offers batik painting, cooking classes, and beach games. The hotel will have your EV charged and ready at the lobby entrance when you need it.

### 4. Tunamaya Beach & Spa Resort (Desaru) ⭐⭐⭐⭐

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **EV charging** | Standard 240V socket (bring portable EVSE) |
| **Price** | MYR 300-500/night (S$90-150) |
| **Family features** | Beachfront chalets, outdoor pool, kids-friendly restaurant |
| **Best for** | Budget-conscious families |

Tunamaya is a quieter, more affordable option just south of the main Desaru Coast resort belt. Not official EV charging, but the resort will let you plug a portable EVSE into the covered parking. 10-12 hours on a 240V socket adds 100-150 km — plenty for local driving.

## What to Do at Desaru Coast with Kids

### Desaru Coast Adventure Waterpark

The centerpiece attraction — 9 themed zones, 20+ slides, wave pool, lazy river, and a massive kids' play area. The **Kampung Tembikar** zone has water play structures designed for younger children (ages 3-8). **Shiro's Epic Adventure** is a 3-story maze with water cannons and tipping buckets.

- **Hours:** 10 AM - 6 PM daily
- **Tickets:** MYR 120 adult, MYR 80 child (online booking discounts available)
- **Pro tip:** Go on a weekday — the waterpark is significantly less crowded

### Desaru Fruit Farm

A 40-minute drive north into the Johor countryside. This 180-acre working fruit farm offers guided tram tours through orchards of durian, mangosteen, rambutan, dragon fruit, and jackfruit. The tour includes unlimited fruit tasting.

- **Hours:** 9 AM - 5 PM daily
- **Tickets:** MYR 35 adult, MYR 25 child (includes tram ride and fruit sampling)
- **Pro tip:** Go in the morning (9-10 AM) before it gets hot

### Beach Time

Desaru Coast's 17 km of beach is the real draw. The sand is soft and golden — not quite white-sand-beach perfection but very good. The water at the resort frontages is clean and swimmable most of the year. The resorts provide beach towels, umbrellas, and chairs for guests.

### Edible Oil Garden & Pesticide-Free Farm

A small but fascinating organic farm near Desaru. Kids can feed goats and rabbits, harvest vegetables, and learn about sustainable farming. MYR 20 entry.

## EV Charging & Cost Breakdown

| Item | Cost (SGD) |
|------|-----------|
| Charging in Singapore (pre-trip) | $5-10 |
| Charging at Desaru Coast (DC Handal, 20 min) | ~MYR 25 = S$8 |
| Return charging (in SG) | $5-10 |
| **Total charging** | **S$18-28** |
| Toll (Malaysia highways) | ~MYR 30 = S$9 |
| Accommodation (2 nights, mid-range) | $300-720 |
| Waterpark tickets (family of 4) | MYR 400 = S$120 |
| Food (3 days) | $150-250 |
| **Total trip cost** | **S$600-1,150 (family of 4)** |

Compare this to taking a petrol car: you'd spend S$25-35 on fuel for the same trip. The EV saves you about S$10-15 in fuel costs — not huge savings on a single trip, but significant if you do this monthly.

## Tips for Singapore-Registered EVs Crossing to Malaysia

### 1. Get Your Touch 'n Go Card Before Crossing

Touch 'n Go is the electronic payment card for all Malaysian toll roads. You can buy one at the Malaysian customs booth (after Singapore immigration) or better yet, get one in advance from any 7-Eleven in Johor Bahru. Load MYR 50-100 for the round trip.

### 2. You Need an Autopass Card

The Malaysian immigration issues an Autopass card for foreign-registered vehicles at the first counter after entering Malaysia. It costs RM 10 and is valid for 30 days. You must return it when you exit Malaysia (or pay a fine of RM 50).

### 3. Vehicle Insurance

Your Singapore insurance covers driving in Malaysia, but only third-party. Consider getting additional comprehensive coverage for Malaysia. Most Singapore insurers offer a Malaysia extension (S$30-50 for 3 days).

### 4. Plan for the Return Queue

The Woodlands Checkpoint returning to Singapore can have heavy queues Sunday afternoon-evening. Use the **Checkpoint.sg** app or check the LTA's OneMotoring website for live traffic camera feeds. If the queue at Woodlands is >1 hour, consider taking the **Second Link (Tuas Checkpoint)** instead — it adds 30 km to your route via Gelang Patah but often has shorter queues.

### 5. Apps to Download for Malaysia

| App | Why |
|-----|-----|
| **JomCharge** | Largest EV network in Malaysia — JB has good coverage |
| **Gentari** | Shell Recharge partner, many stations on SDE highway |
| **PlugShare** | User-submitted charger reviews and availability |
| **Waze** | Better than Google Maps for Malaysian traffic — has toll cost display |
| **Touch 'n Go eWallet** | Top up your TnG card digitally |

## Charging Strategy Summary

| Option | When | Cost | Best For |
|--------|------|------|----------|
| Charge in SG before crossing | Before departure | S$5-10 | Peace of mind, short-range EVs |
| Charge at R&R Layang-Layang | En route (40 km into drive) | MYR 15-25 | Family break + top-up |
| Charge at DC Handal Riverside | Arrival at Desaru | MYR 20-30 | Full charge in 20 min |
| Charge at hotel overnight | All weekend | Free | Zero-effort top-up |
| Don't charge at all | Range permitting | $0 | Only with 250+ km real-world range |

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I make the Singapore to Desaru trip without charging?

Yes, if your EV has 200+ km real-world range. The drive is only 80-100 km. Most EVs sold in Singapore (BYD Atto 3, Tesla Model 3/Y, Hyundai Ioniq 5/6, Kia EV6, MG4, Mercedes EQA/B/EQE, BMW iX1/i4) can do the round trip on a single charge without issue.

### Do the Desaru Coast resorts actually have working EV charging?

Yes. The Hard Rock and Westin have multiple AC Type 2 chargers. They're maintained by the resort — not the hit-or-miss public network. Ask the front desk to confirm availability when you book.

### What about the new Tesla Supercharger in JB?

There's a Tesla Supercharger at AEON Mall Tebrau City (in JB, about 15 minutes from the causeway). 150kW, 4 stalls. If you're driving a Tesla, this is the fastest option in the area. It's a 5-minute detour from the EDL.

### Is Desaru Coast safe for kids?

Very safe. The resort development is gated and patrolled. The beaches have lifeguards at the resort frontages. The waterpark is professionally managed. Desaru is a family-first destination.

### What if the DC Handal 200kW charger is occupied?

It only has 2 connectors (120kW each in shared mode), so it can be busy on weekends. Your backup options:
1. Hotel AC charging (free, overnight)
2. JomCharge at R&R Layang-Layang (50kW, on the highway back toward JB)
3. Gentari at Bandar Penawar (50kW, 10 minutes south of Desaru Coast)

### Can I bring my portable EVSE to a non-EV hotel?

Yes — Tunamaya and smaller guesthouses near Desaru will let you plug into standard sockets for a small fee. A 240V/15A plug adds 6-7 km/hour — enough for an overnight top-up.

## The Bottom Line

The Singapore to Desaru Coast EV road trip is the easiest cross-border family adventure in Southeast Asia. Short distance, good highways, reliable charging options, and world-class family resorts that genuinely support EV drivers.

Total driving time: approximately 1.5-2.5 hours depending on border wait. Total charging cost: under S$30 for the entire weekend. Family fun level: off the charts.

For a first EV road trip with the family — whether you're a new EV owner or a seasoned road-tripper — Desaru Coast is the perfect destination. Pack the swimsuits, preload the Touch 'n Go, and hit the SDE highway.
